title: The Rise of Generative AI
description: Exploring how generative models moved beyond text into images, audio, and video.
bodyHtml:
Exploring how generative models moved beyond text into images, audio, and video.

Generative AI, powered by models like GPT and diffusion-based image generators, is reshaping how we create content. These models generate realistic text, images, and video, pushing the boundaries of creativity and automation.

  • Applications span design, entertainment, and software development
  • Raises open questions about originality and attribution

title: AI in Healthcare
description: How AI is transforming diagnostics and patient care. AI is making strides in healthcare through predictive analytics and personalized medicine.
bodyHtml:
How AI is transforming diagnostics and patient care.

AI is making strides in healthcare through predictive analytics and personalized medicine. From diagnostic systems to surgical robotics, AI is helping doctors detect disease earlier and tailor treatment to individual patients.

title: Why I Write Notes in Public
description: A short note on why this site exists. I write notes as I learn so future-me (and maybe you) can find them again.
bodyHtml:
A short note on why this site exists.

I write notes as I learn so future-me (and maybe you) can find them again. This site is intentionally simple: Markdown files, a tiny build script, and static hosting.
